rules.source: Washington My Health My Data Act (HB 1155, 2023; RCW 19.373) — https://www.atg.wa.gov/protecting-washingtonians-personal-health-data-and-privacy
rules.retrieved_snippet: Washington AG: signed April 27, 2023; requires a distinct consumer health data privacy policy, consent to collect or share, valid authorization to sell, deletion rights, and limits on geofencing health facilities; violations are per se Consumer Protection Act violations enforceable by the AG and by private action; compliance from March 31, 2024 (June 30, 2024 for small businesses).
